data.rationale: The proposal captures the same procedure and parameters (arXiv advanced search with topic, category and year, then the Semantic Scholar citation count, then a Notes entry), but it adds an unsupported "Title" field restriction, gets the first-author step slightly wrong by reading it on Semantic Scholar instead of arXiv, and omits closing the Semantic Scholar tab, so it is concrete enough to automate with minor fixes.
